text:
sara: quick question for API contract folks — for /v1/generate usage we currently return usage.prompt_tokens and usage.completion_tokens. Billing asks for clearer visibility into what was served from cache. Do we add fields or keep reconciliations external?

diego: we should expose it. otherwise billing ends up diffing request traces with imperfect heuristics. keep it opt-in.

pramod: opt-in sounds safe. many SDKs deserialize usage.* into a TokenUsage object; adding optional keys is fine but avoid renaming existing ones.

kate: can we be more granular than a single cached_tokens? e.g., distinguish prompt vs completion cache hits. that helps contract reconciliation with legacy billing rules.

sara: proposal: add usage.cached_prompt_tokens (int, optional), usage.cached_completion_tokens (int, optional), usage.cache_layer (string, optional) with enum values ["prefix","kv","llm_cache","none"], and an optional convenience usage.billable_tokens (int) computed as prompt + completion - cached_prompt - cached_completion.

mike: how do we guarantee backward compatibility for consumers that parse only prompt_tokens/completion_tokens? adding optional fields is fine, but doc the semantics.

diego: definition suggestions: cached_prompt_tokens = number of prompt-side tokens satisfied entirely from server cache; cached_completion_tokens = number of completion-side tokens never generated because cache supplied them. Both only count tokens that would otherwise be chargeable.

pramod: add telemetry: emit metrics per request: telemetry.cached_prompt_tokens, telemetry.cached_completion_tokens, and tag by cache_layer. That makes aggregate recon straightforward.

kate: billing: any objections? @billing-bot please confirm contract impacts.

billing-bot: billing: OK with per-side cached counts. We want the raw numbers; we will compute billable units ourselves, but billable_tokens convenience field fine if documented. Update: need a mapping in the contract spreadsheet.

sara: example response shape for docs (note: optional fields may be omitted):

```
{
  "id": "resp_abc123",
  "output": "...",
  "usage": {
    "prompt_tokens": 140,
    "completion_tokens": 60,
    "cached_prompt_tokens": 30,       // optional
    "cached_completion_tokens": 10,  // optional
    "cache_layer": "prefix",       // optional enum
    "billable_tokens": 160           // optional convenience
  }
}
```

mike: SDK impact: add two nullable ints and one nullable string to TokenUsage. Ship minor patch, default null. Add changelog entry.

pramod: tests: unit covers cases (no cache, prefix hits, kv hits) and e2e to verify telemetry tagging. I will add sample fixtures for billing to validate spreadsheets.

kate: compatibility gotchas to call out in docs: some customers assert presence of completion_tokens — do not change semantics of existing fields; new fields must be optional and additive only. Also document rounding rules and whether partial token matches count (we should not count partials).

diego: note: counting semantics: only count whole tokens satisfied by cache. If a cache returns partial prefix causing fewer decoding steps, we do NOT double-count partials; stick to whole-token accounting.

mike: implementation question: where to compute cached_completion_tokens? runtime will know when it bypasses generation vs when it replays cached tokens from KV. We'll emit the counts at response time.

sara: next steps
- eng-platform: add optional fields to schema + open PR with example fixtures (me)
- runtime: emit the new counters and tag cache_layer (diego)
- SDKs: handle nullable fields + changelog (mike)
- billing: update recon sheet and validation tests (billing team)
- docs: add explicit section on token accounting semantics and a few examples (pramod)

pramod: I'll draft the doc wording to avoid ambiguous language about "charged vs consumed" tokens.

kate: ok if we opt into this for the next minor release? then we can roll to GA after billing validates spreadsheets.

sara: no objections. i'll open the PR with schema PR and include the example responses and unit test stubs. tagging everyone for review. thanks :tada:
